label: Salt formation (K15 base), guidance recovery vs short-MD length, window placed immediately before the origin frame, 6 statistics (L2 re-measurement of L63-L68)

length_definition.unit: covered length (ns); window = the last n_frames of the 0-1 ns history, ending at the origin frame 10 (E01 Protocol A placement)

base: K15 base: train 58 / test 30 proteins (split.json orig + additions), static 5 features, HistGBM (120 iters, lr 0.075, 31 leaves, min_samples_leaf 15, L2 0.02, seed 42) retrained per condition; history features per covered length = 6 statistics of the window (first frame of the window, mean, std, min, frame 10 minus first frame of the window, fraction <= 4.0 A); full_history = static + the same 6 statistics over all 11 frames; recovery denominator = full-history gain, as in L63-L68
premise_checks: see premise_check.json (all_ok required before the main phase)

references.source: L63-L68 records (K15 / K2-135 values and the mean-only recovery remeasured there)

bootstrap.resampling_unit: protein (30 test proteins, resampled with replacement)
bootstrap.note: Bootstrap intervals are computed for the 6-statistics curve. Within each resample, static-only, full-history and suffix-stats6 AUPRCs are recomputed from the saved per-candidate predictions and the gain and recovery are recomputed inside the sample. Models are not refit. Pooled AUPRC uses a numpy implementation of sklearn average_precision_score (threshold-grouped), verified against sklearn to <1e-9 on the full test set for every bootstrapped condition.
